reauthentification_requise.title: Auto Backup: destination “{nom}” must be re-authorized
reauthentification_requise.description:
Provider “{fournisseur}” refused to renew access for destination “{nom}”: the authorization expired or was revoked. Other destinations keep working.

This issue is listed under Settings → System → Repairs. To resolve it, open the Auto Backup integration options (“Configure”), choose “Re-authorize a destination” and select “{nom}”.

notification_echec_message.message:
Backup “{sauvegarde}” could not be uploaded to destination “{destination}”.

**Cause**: {cause}

Consecutive failures for this destination: {echecs}.

The local backup itself is intact. This notification will disappear on its own as soon as an upload to this destination succeeds.

notification_reauth_titre.message: Auto Backup: destination “{destination}” must be re-authorized

notification_reauth_message.message:
Provider “{fournisseur}” refused to renew access for destination “{destination}”: the authorization expired or was revoked. No more backups will be sent to it; other destinations keep working.

To restore it, open the Auto Backup integration options (“Configure”), choose “Re-authorize a destination”, then “{destination}”.

This notification and the issue listed under Settings → System → Repairs will disappear together, when the destination is re-authorized or removed.

erreur_access_revoked.message: access to the destination was revoked or has expired: re-authorize it from the integration options

erreur_missing_scope.message: the destination's authorization lacks a permission: re-authorize it and grant every requested permission

erreur_quota_exceeded.message: the account's storage is full: free up space with the provider or reduce the retention

erreur_rate_limited.message: the provider is temporarily limiting the number of requests: try again later

erreur_timeout.message: the time limit was exceeded: the provider did not answer in time or the upload took too long

erreur_network_error.message: the provider cannot be reached: check Home Assistant's Internet connection

erreur_provider_unavailable.message: the provider is temporarily unavailable: try again later

erreur_invalid_folder.message: the destination's remote folder is invalid or rejected by the provider: check the configured folder

erreur_api_disabled.message: the Google Drive API is not enabled on your Google Cloud project: enable “Google Drive API” under “APIs & Services” > “Library”, then try again

erreur_not_found.message: the requested item does not exist (any more) at the provider

erreur_unknown_destination.message: the destination no longer exists: it may have been removed since the action was called

erreur_local_backup_unreadable.message: the local backup could not be read for upload: details are in the Home Assistant log

erreur_invalid_config.message: the destination's configuration is invalid or incomplete: details are in the Home Assistant log

erreur_unknown_provider.message: the destination's provider is not supported by this version of Auto Backup

erreur_unknown.message: unexpected error: details are in the Home Assistant log

destination_inconnue_sans_destination.message: Unknown destination: “{destination}”. No remote destination is configured.

destination_ambigue.message: Several destinations are named “{destination}”: specify its identifier ({identifiants}).

televersement_indisponible.message: Remote upload is unavailable: the Auto Backup entry is not loaded.

identifiants.title: Your application credentials
identifiants.description:
Create an application with “{fournisseur}”, then declare this redirect URL in it:

`{url_de_retour}`

Then enter that application's client ID and secret below. They stay in your Home Assistant instance and are never logged.

data_description.client_id: Identifier of the application you created with the provider.
data_description.client_secret: Secret of that same application. It is stored in Home Assistant and never logged.

autorisation.title: Authorization
autorisation.description: Authorize Auto Backup in the window that just opened, then come back here.

destination.title: New destination
destination.description: Provider “{fournisseur}”. Name this destination, choose the remote folder backups are uploaded to and, optionally, a retention of its own.

data_description.name: Shown in the destination's entities and accepted by the “upload_to” field of the backup actions.
data_description.folder: Relative path, at the provider, where backups are stored. Use one folder per Home Assistant instance.
data_description.retention_days: Remote backups older than this many days are deleted. Leave empty for no age limit.
data_description.retention_count: Beyond this number, the oldest remote backups are deleted. Leave empty for no limit. Without any retention, the destination is never purged.

modifier_destination.title: Edit a destination
modifier_destination.description: Choose the destination whose name, remote folder or retention you want to change. Its authorization is kept: you will not be asked to sign in to the provider again.

data_description.destination_id: To change account or provider, use “Re-authorize a destination” instead, or add a new destination.

parametres_destination.title: Edit “{destination}”
parametres_destination.description:
Provider “{fournisseur}”. Change the name, remote folder or retention of this destination. Its authorization, its entities and the list of backups it has already uploaded are kept.

Changing the remote folder will ask for confirmation: backups in the previous folder will no longer be listed or purged by Auto Backup.

data_description.name: Shown in the destination's entities and accepted by the “upload_to” field of the backup actions. Entities keep their identifier; only their displayed name changes.
data_description.folder: Relative path, at the provider, where backups are stored. Use one folder per Home Assistant instance. Backups in the previous folder are not moved.
data_description.retention_days: Remote backups older than this many days are deleted. Leave empty for no age limit.
data_description.retention_count: Beyond this number, the oldest remote backups are deleted. Leave empty for no limit. Without any retention, the destination is never purged.
data_description.auto_purge: Setting shared by the whole integration: it applies to local backups and to every destination. When enabled, retention is applied after each successful upload; otherwise only when the “auto_backup.purge” action is called.

reautoriser_destination.title: Re-authorize a destination
reautoriser_destination.description: Choose the destination whose access must be renewed. Other destinations are left untouched.

data_description.destination_id: Only destinations that use an authorization are listed.

confirmer_changement_de_compte.title: Account change

data_description.confirmer: Leave unchecked to keep the destination as it was.

confirmer_changement_de_dossier.title: Remote folder change

data_description.confirmer: Leave unchecked to keep the destination as it was.

supprimer_destination.title: Remove a destination
supprimer_destination.description: The configuration and authorization of the chosen destinations will be erased. Backups already uploaded to the provider are not deleted.

data_description.destinations: Backups already stored with the provider are kept.

reglages_notifications.title: Notification settings
reglages_notifications.description:
When a backup definitively fails to reach a remote destination, Auto Backup can show a persistent notification naming the destination, the backup and the cause. A destination never has more than one such notification: it is updated on each new failure and disappears as soon as an upload succeeds.

Turned off, notifications are no longer created: the “auto_backup.upload_failed” event, the error log and the repair issue reporting a destination to re-authorize are all kept.

data.notify_on_failure: Notify upload failures and access to renew

data_description.notify_on_failure: When turned off, the event, the error log and the repair issue are still emitted.

reglages_televersement.title: Upload settings
reglages_televersement.description: Maximum time allowed to send a backup to a remote destination. Past that, the upload is aborted and reported through the “auto_backup.upload_failed” event; the local backup itself is left untouched. Allow plenty of time for a large backup or a slow connection.

data_description.upload_timeout: Whole number of seconds, greater than zero.
